You can close this tab and go back to the app.

• **Metronome** A new Metronome tab clicks with accents, subdivisions and five sounds, and a song's screen clicks along at that song's own tempo.
• **Capo and tempo on the song** Step the capo and tempo right on the song, separately for each setlist, without changing the song file.
• **Choose your features** A new Features tab in Settings turns the metronome, setlists, chords or cover art off, and Performance mode is now called Read only.
• **Song settings sync** Dropbox sync now carries the transposition, capo and tempo you set on songs opened from the library, so every device plays them alike.
• **The key you hear** Song cards and the song's header name the key the band hears, capo applied, and the tempo it is played at.
• **Unreadable lines in the editor** The editor shows a key, capo, tempo or other setting it cannot read in red, since the song is read without it.
